$comment: Example GAH providers config. Copy to ~/.gah/providers.json (or point GAH_PROVIDERS_FILE at it) and replace with your approved endpoints. NOTE: providers using cloud credential-chain auth (e.g. amazon-bedrock) are allowlisted via the GAH_BUILTIN_MODELS env var instead, e.g. GAH_BUILTIN_MODELS='amazon-bedrock/anthropic.claude-opus*' — see docs/PROVIDERS.md.

providers.name: acme-gateway
providers.$comment: apiKey: a literal, "$ENV_VAR" resolved per request, or omitted so /login collects it into auth.json

providers.name: locked-down-gateway
providers.$comment: tools: "native" (default) sends real tool definitions; "prompted" is for a gateway that refuses them: tools go in the system prompt and the model's ```tool blocks are parsed back into calls. Per-model override with the same key inside a model. See docs/PROVIDERS.md.
